scope: Native resource ownership, lookup authorization, and root enumeration
invariant: Native resource lookups enforce application identity and explicit public-resource exceptions.
required_evidence: Missing-feature failures against the preceding native server
Positive same-application access and negative cross-application access
Root enumeration filtering and root pixel/property denial
Independent native attacks against windows, pixmaps, graphics contexts, properties, and events
Connection teardown, revocation, and retained-resource denial
Focused instrumented native server checks with the GLX limitation recorded
limitations: This component does not complete native resource isolation or M04.
Extension dispatch, atoms, selections, device access, aliases, and asynchronous metadata still require qualification.
Strict mode remains explicit. Trusted diagnostic mode is not an application security boundary.
Do not connect untrusted applications before the complete native boundary and broker provisioning pass.
